scope: Read-only review of snapshotted first-start readiness implementation; no source, build, Simulator or protected-test operations.

materialFindings.finding: Renderer records carry kind and isReady but no preparation request ID. consume checks only isPending and booleans. A ready snapshot created for request A satisfies request B after cancel and requestFirstStart; child environment comparisons do not make the parent gate itself reject an old snapshot.
materialFindings.suggestion: Carry the preparation ID with each record and require exact current-request equality at consume. Include cancel/new-request plus old ready snapshot regression. Scheduled child publication should also verify current generation where possible; never let a late stale assignment certify a new request.

materialFindings.finding: The synchronized ID is a one-way latch for a start request. Readiness is not invalidated when the same mounted host changes pose/fingers/side, board position/contact selection or viewport. Hand choice and task controls remain available before routineStartedAt. A new value can therefore inherit a true readiness record before its new synchronization completes.
materialFindings.suggestion: Invalidate/reissue pending preparation on a resolved cue/presentation/layout signature change, or carry and verify each current input signature in host readiness. Preserve intent and Main hand choice rather than disabling required selection. Test same-host side/pose/viewport change while another host remains pending.

boundedAdditionalRisks.finding: Parent computes requiresBoard by constructing a fresh BoardMapPresentationSelection, while BoardMapView retains its own presentationSelection and permits surface/position selection. A mixed raster/model package switched during preparation can disagree with this inferred requirement. Current-renderer preference presence helps reject unready models but does not make the required kind identical to displayed state.
boundedAdditionalRisks.suggestion: Derive readiness requirements from actual displayed map content or prevent stale inferred requirements; validate mixed-media/presentation change, not only default Evo.

boundedAdditionalRisks.finding: BoardFrameImageView has no readiness publication. BoardModelSurface emits empty pendingPreparation once .ready. Thus requiresBoard=true never completes under usesFrameRenderer; this remains disabled-by-default DEBUG path, not the normal live candidate.
boundedAdditionalRisks.suggestion: Explicitly retain this as unsupported until a completed-frame readiness signal exists; do not silently release it as ready.

boundedAdditionalRisks.finding: Readiness requires root.scene inside make/update. If content.add has not yet attached on make, no readiness is emitted until a later update. Existing camera invalidation can trigger updates, but pure aggregation tests do not establish this lifecycle path or parent/child preference propagation.
boundedAdditionalRisks.suggestion: Actual hosted startup proof must show load to attached/synchronized readiness reaches the parent and releases. Do not infer it from dictionary tests alone; no runtime defect asserted here.

boundedAdditionalRisks.finding: Opacity zero retains SwiftUI structural hand identity and avoids the prior conditional deletion, but cannot prove RealityKit continues drawing or that a visible frame exists before Hang. The candidate still needs first-Hang whole-image evidence.

Initial countdown now keeps portrait cue cards and landscape single-hand cue cards at opacity zero and hit testing disabled; their text/accessibility elements are not explicitly hidden by this change. Paired RealityView is already AX-hidden, but cue card text may remain discoverable.
boundedAdditionalRisks.suggestion: Keep countdown hidden-cue accessibility consistent with former absent subtree if testing confirms exposure.

positiveChecks: Loader loading/unavailable contributes false board readiness; hand availability participates, so neither is deliberately treated as success.
Finite positive viewport and actual attached scene are checked before publication; this is stronger than resource-cache/prewarm readiness, without claiming displayed-frame proof.
Initial-only request hook leaves resume and skip request paths separate. Existing audio preparation/arm logic follows gate release rather than running before visual preparation.

Cancellation is integrated into pending-start toggle, interruption/end helper and disappearance. Root already owns explicit cancelCountdown reset and empty-preference start fixes, so those known items are not duplicated as new findings.
Current hand construction still uses Main task/selected-side and portrait single-side logic. Pair and single hosts remain actual normal renderer types; no mesh/material/camera replacement.
Keeping the same branch via mountedCueCountdown should avoid countdown-driven removal of the existing hand State storage; actual renderer lifetime still needs validation.

testScope.existingCoverage: Missing/ready board and hand entries, all mounted records, replacement dictionary, unavailable hand, empty non-model state.
missingMeaningfulBoundaries: request A ready snapshot rejected after cancel/new request B
same-host resolved-content change invalidates prior readiness
hosted child preference propagation/loading-to-ready and cancellation
hidden countdown host identity retained through Hang

conclusion: Resolve request/input freshness before treating the gate as robust. These findings do not establish a GPU-frame guarantee or a fix to historical late-color failures. No acceptance or runtime outcome inferred.
